review.tagline: 2B-parameter text-to-speech model with voice design and voice cloning
review.summary: VoxCPM2 is a 2B-parameter, tokenizer-free TTS model built on a MiniCPM-4 backbone. It synthesizes 48kHz speech in 30 languages, creates voices from a text description, and clones voices from a short reference clip, optionally with a transcript for continuation cloning. It ships as a pip package with a Python API, CLI and web demo, and can be served through Nano-vLLM, vLLM-Omni or llama.cpp-omni.
review.audience: Developers needing self-hosted multilingual TTS, voice design or voice cloning
strengths: Voice design from a text description, no reference audio needed
30 languages plus nine Chinese dialects, no language tag required
Apache-2.0 weights and code, with SFT and LoRA fine-tuning support
Serving options: Nano-vLLM, vLLM-Omni (OpenAI-style endpoint), GGUF on llama.cpp-omni
weaknesses: Standard install requires CUDA 12.0 or newer and PyTorch 2.5.0 or newer
RTF about 0.3 on RTX 4090 with the default PyTorch path
llama.cpp-omni path is slower: RTF about 1.76 on Apple M4 Pro
